text:
rachel: quick heads-upfound a confusing paragraph in error-ref/limits.md: it suggests client-side full-stream retries which can duplicate tokens. need a small PR clarifying safe retry boundaries and showing resume-token example.

omar: agreed. i've seen two support tickets about duplicated output. recommend adding: use SDK resume tokens or idempotency checkpoints instead of re-sending the whole prompt.

jin: drafting snippet now. plan: show `sdk.stream.create()` + try/catch and `sdk.stream.resume(token)` fallback. will also add a tiny backoff table (attempts, base, max, jitter).

rachel: add a migration note for teams still using `X-Retry-After` header and a one-liner about trimming prompts (trim assistant then user then system).

infra-bot: docs-ci triggered for PR draft checks: lint/linkcheck/spell.

omar: opened draft PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1115 includes snippet and backoff table. tagging jin for review.

jin: pushed updates; fixed link to StreamInterrupts and replaced external blog with archived copy. small wording tweaks.

infra-bot: docs-ci passed preview: https://docs-preview.redwood/error-ref/limits?pr=1115

rachel: merged. updated CHANGELOG.md (docs v1.15.1) and posted short note in #release-notes. closing thread after monitoring for support regressions. :shipit:
